name: or-lens
description: Debug LP/MPS optimization models on this computer: diagnostics, matrix views, verified conflicts and HiGHS solves.

interface.longDescription: OR Lens opens LP and MPS models on this computer and explains them with computed facts: model summary, coefficient ranges, diagnostics, the sparse matrix, name-based families, verified infeasibility conflicts and HiGHS solves. The workbench opens next to the chat; model files and computation stay local.
defaultPrompt: Use OR Lens to explain why /path/to/model.lp is infeasible.
Use OR Lens to find out why /path/to/model.mps solves slowly.
Open /path/to/model.lp in OR Lens and summarize its diagnostics.
